plan.notes: Source: https://acu.edu/wp-content/uploads/2026/07/Criminal-Justice-BS.pdf (official ACU Online degree plan, 2026-2027 Academic Year, College of Leadership and Professional Studies, 100% ONLINE, 120 credit hours). Hand-transcribed 2026-09-30. Caveats: (1) The supplement requirement text says 'GVTO 225, GVTO 384, and PLSO 315 are required'; the research-methods course is actually listed as 'GVTO 315: Political Science and Criminal Justice Research Methods' (PLSO 315 appears to be a typo). Modeled as GVTO 315. (2) The supplement is labeled '15 hours' but names 3 required + 3 chosen courses (18 hrs); GVTO 225 (National Government) is modeled as a gen-ed University Requirement (it also fulfills a standard gen-ed government requirement), leaving 15 supplement hours in the major: 27 (CRMO) + 15 = 42 major hrs; 42 + 22 electives + 56 gen-ed = 120. (3) CRMO 499 is 'available for variable credit'; modeled as 3 hrs. (4) Semester placement is a recommended sequence; the PDF does not publish a semester-by-semester layout. No course prerequisites are stated in the PDF.
